status: source audit plus actual public text-shape probe; whole SDK owned-copy coverage remains unknown

sources.boundary: appendPlainText selects a paragraph separator only for a nonempty document
owned piece-table QString append can copy its initialized prefix on COW or growth
insertText appends the complete input UTF-16 buffer before fragment insertion
QTextBlock::text reserves and copies fragment text into a fresh QString
validate obtains QTextBlock::text; invocation count is not observed
layout/paint may rebuild text and glyph buffers; default cacheGlyphs is false
DisplayRole QVariant retains QString; equal display values return without emitDataChanged
paint delegates to the actual widget style, so storage sharing does not prove painting has no owned text
calculateElidedText appends line text into a fresh QString even on its nonelided branch

observer.scope: piece-table text append only; input QString construction counted separately
assumptions: no text deletion/clear, newline, paragraph or fragment-control character
installed and compile-time Qt versions are exactly 6.11.1
observer.conservative_utf16_units: (separator ? C+1 : 0) + (L ? C+separator+L : 0), separator=0 when the document was empty, else 1
observer.capacity: private and unobserved; every append can conservatively relocate the prior initialized prefix

not_covered: QTextBlock::text owned UTF-16 copies during layout/paint
text-engine shaping buffers and glyph arrays
QTreeWidget delegate/font text and layout copies
other Qt or VTK SDK CPU payload buffers
actual native style, QTreeWidget paint call count and calculateElidedText owned QString output
